Detailed Description

A basic Actor in charge of spawning Enemy Characters and monitoring their deaths. Enemies will be spawned one by one, and the spawner will wait until the enemy dies before spawning a new one. The spawner can be remotely activated through the ICombatActivatable interface When the last spawned enemy dies, the spawner can also activate other ICombatActivatables
